newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas to keep 37 pct of Havas Advertising.
newsitem.headline: Havas to keep 37 pct of Havas Advertising.

text.p: Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier said on Thursday he wanted to keep the group's 37 percent stake in Havas Advertising, but envisaged reducing the holding to 20 percent in the event that Havas Advertising went into an alliance to further its international development.

"We've always been minority shareholders in Havas Advertising. Our stake has fluctuated between 35 and 40 percent...today we've decided to stay at 37 percent," he told a news conference to announce a restructuring of the media activities held by Havas and Generale des Eaux.
He said Havas could change its position if Havas Advertising head Alain de Pouzilhac came up with an attractive development project.
"If Alain de Pouzilhac has an external growth project...which is interesting in terms of development and market share conquest, I would be ready to go down to 20 percent but not below," Dauzier said.
